sentences: The Mandelbrot set consists of complex parameters for which repeatedly applying the associated quadratic map to zero gives a bounded orbit.
The computability question asks whether one program can approximate this entire compact set to every requested accuracy.
This is stronger than producing convincing images at selected resolutions or testing many individual parameters.
The source cites the question as motivation for studying computability and semicomputability of geometric sets.
A solution would connect effective approximation of a familiar fractal with rigorous information about the global behavior of complex dynamical systems.
